title: Leaf Bag
notes: Tree of Life: easier on the eyes. The tree now shows only its slots (5 Seeds, 3 Boughs, 1 Crown and the 3 hollows). A Leaf Bag on the left holds the route's Seeds, Boughs and Crowns: drag one onto an empty slot of its kind to grow it (or double-click it).
A Rune Bag in the bottom right holds your rune stones: drag one onto an open hollow (on the trunk or in the Hollows row).

Alchemist: new True passive in Mixing, Self-Stirring Crucible. In a fight it pours one of your learned Mixes into the Crucible every few seconds, never one that would make the brew Unstable, for 150% of the Mix's mana, and your Potion hits deal a little more damage while it's on.
Every True passive (the Executioner's Creed and Self-Stirring Crucible) can now be switched off and on by right-clicking it in the skill tree.
